name: Smoky Beef Enchiladas
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Soften the chopped onions in half the oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the mince, cumin, paprika and chilli flakes, turn the heat up and brown for 4 to 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Dissolve the stock cube and tomato puree in 400ml hot water, pour into the pan and simmer for 5 minutes until thick and no longer wet.
Divide the mince between the wraps, roll up and place in an oiled dish. Top with the grated cheese and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Chop the tomatoes, spring onion and coriander with a splash of oil for a quick salsa and spoon over to serve.
